Who we are
Why we exist and what we believe in
Faced with piles of resumes and no reliable way to identify the best talent, Wouter Durville and Otto Verhage founded TestGorilla in 2019 to make hiring faster, fairer, and smarter.
To help one billion people land their dream jobs through the power of skills-based hiring.
To create a world where job opportunities are democratized and candidates are judged by what they can do, not just what’s on their resume.
Our spokespeople
Meet the voices of TestGorilla
Wouter Durville
CEO and Co-Founder
Wouter leads TestGorilla's mission to make hiring faster, fairer, and more predictive. A former Bain & Company consultant and serial social entrepreneur, he's a leading voice on skills-based hiring and DE&I, a WEF Global Innovators member, and a Netherlands 'Leading Entrepreneur in Tech' nominee.
Otto Verhage
COO and Co-Founder
Otto oversees operations, product, engineering, and customer success. Previously a Partner at Bain & Company, he brings deep expertise in strategy, growth, and customer experience.
Chris Newton
VP of Engineering
Chris is VP of Engineering at TestGorilla, leading AI, product engineering, data, and platform engineering. With over 20 years of experience spanning FTSE 50 companies and high-growth startups, Chris has built and scaled engineering teams at Just Eat, Immersive, and Send.
Olive Turon
Head of People and Culture
Olive drives the company's inclusive, purpose-led culture and organizational growth. She brings rich experience from Google, FinTech, and HR Tech, shaping strategies into operational reality.
Megan Bourdages
VP of Go-to-Market
Megan leads TestGorilla's global Go-to-Market (GTM) organization. Since 2014, she has specialized in the HR tech space, leading assessment initiatives for organizations ranging from high-growth startups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
Claudia Baijens
VP of Product
Claudia Baijens is the VP of Product at TestGorilla, where she leads the product, UX, research, science, and IP development teams in building a platform that redefines how organizations discover and hire top talent.
